quote: The worst thing we can do as leaders is set people up to fail. I focus on setting clear, achievable expectations and empowering my team with the knowledge they need to succeed. Regular one-on-one conversations help build trust, foster connection, and keep communication open. With that same mindset, I'm genuinely excited about the opportunity to work with Fulton County and our team to elevate operations and drive meaningful impact.
speaker: Anthony Benavidez
title: Proposed Project Manager
